page.layout: One page of text, running head at top centre with page number at top right; main text in one block; a small marginal note at the right beside the paragraph XXVI; a catchword/signature line at the foot "Rr 2 DISSER-" (signature and catchword at bottom right). Faint show-through of the other side in the lower half, not transcribed.

main_text.p: flagrantes, adeóque sancto perfectóque odio odisse coeperunt. In Anglia enim post Eduardum & Johannam Grajam Elisabetha Ecclesiæ se addixit tota. In Scotia Mariæ Jacobus vi. successit, & Regnum à Babylonis tyrannide liberavit. In Suecia in locum Sigismundi persecutoris, qui Poloniæ Rex factus est, Carolus patruus ejus subiit, doctrinæ Euangelicæ addictus. In Dania & Norwegia Christierno Fridericus succesit, Euangelicam veritatem ipse quoque amplexus. Taceo, quod in Gallia quoque, Hungaria, Bohemia, Polonia, Belgio Hispanico Euangelicis pactorum vi religionis libertas concessa est; & apud quosdam effectum est, si non ut veritatem amarent, tamen ut meretricem odio haberent, ejusque carnes comederent: qua de re in loco pluribus agendum fuerit.
main_text.head: XXVI. Concludimus, Hierarchiam, seu Clerum Ecclesiæ Romanæ dominantem, Bestiam septicipitem, septimontiam & διναμεγίνου habere sibi obnoxiam parentémque, adeóque cæteris partibus, Babylonem Magnam esse. "Οπερ εἰδον δἐζαι.

page.notes: Marginal note at right beside XXVI is partly illegible ("Argumen-tum concludi-ditur"). Greek line at end of XXVI is uncertain. Lower half of the page shows faint show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed.
